main_body: Drawer chest with a 5x4 grid of small drawers with yellow handles, standing against a wall, with a jar and a small item on top
top_band: Light salmon-brown band at rows 3-5, about 3 rows tall, then dark brown face from row 6
evidence: Down the middle column there is a light band at rows 3-5, then the dark brown front from row 6 to about 28. The band reads as a thin cap or rim, about 3 rows on a roughly 28-row object, much shallower than the 5-row top in the green cabinet guide. There is no distinct lighter front-edge line. The drawers are painted flat on the face, with a light upper stripe and a dark lower stripe, and do not look inset. The whole body is a front elevation with a thin hat, so it fails.

style.evidence: The drawers repeat one 3-tone brown pattern with yellow handles. The dark brown gaps between drawers and the dark body are large flat fills. The outline is a dark brown tint, which is correct. Shading has about 4 steps and little grain, so tiles carry fewer colours than the richly textured stall and well references. It looks thinner and more repetitive than the reference.
